<style>
/* Yorkshire Housing Brand Compliance Styles - Version 2.0 */

/* ===== DEBUGGING HELPER =====
    body:after {
        content: "YH Brand Loaded ✓";
        position: fixed;
        top: 10px;
        right: 10px;
        background: #4fc3ae;
        color: white;
        padding: 5px 10px;
        z-index: 10000;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', Arial, sans-serif;
    } **/

:root {
    /* Primary Palette */
    --yh-purple: #34215a;
    --yh-rose: #f04d6e;
    --yh-yellow: #f9ab23;
    --yh-green: #4fc3ae;
    --yh-white: #fff;

    /* Specialty Colors */
    --yh-dark-purple: #1a112d;
    --yh-light-purple: #857a9c;
    --yh-lightest-purple: #ece6f9;
    --yh-light-rose: #f694a8;
    --yh-lightest-rose: #ffeef1;


    /* Type Scale - Based on 12pt body (16px) */
    --body-size: 14px;
    /* 12pt equivalent */
    --body-leading: 14px;
    /* 16pt leading (12pt + 4pt) */

    --subhead-size: 16px;
    /* 24pt - 2x body size */
    --subhead-leading: 16px;
    /* 32pt leading (24pt + 8pt) */

    --headline-size: 18px;
    /* 35pt - 3x body size */
    --headline-leading: 18px;
    /* 44pt leading (36pt + 8pt) */

    --superhead-size: 65px;
    /* 72pt - 4x body size */
    --superhead-leading: 65px;
    /* 72pt leading (48pt + 8pt) */

    --lwc-pageHeaderColorBorder: #34215a;

    --search-visible: visible;
}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE DESIGN ===== */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    :root {
        --body-size: 12px;
        --body-leading: 12px;
        --subhead-size: 14px;
        --subhead-leading: 14px;
        --headline-size: 16px;
        --headline-leading: 16px;
        --superhead-size: 28px;
        --superhead-leading: 28px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    :root {
        --body-size: 10px;
        --body-leading: 10px;
        --subhead-size: 12px;
        --subhead-leading: 12px;
        --headline-size: 14px;
        --headline-leading: 14px;
        --superhead-size: 18px;
        --superhead-leading: 18px;
    }
}

/* ===== UTILITY CLASSES ===== */
.yh-bg-purple {
    background-color: #34215a !important;
}

.yh-bg-rose {
    background-color: #f04d6e !important;
}

.yh-bg-yellow {
    background-color: #f9ab23 !important;
}

.yh-bg-green {
    background-color: #4fc3ae !important;
}

.yh-text-purple {
    color: #34215a !important;
}

.yh-text-rose {
    color: #f04d6e !important;
}

.yh-text-yellow {
    color: #f9ab23 !important;
}

.yh-text-green {
    color: #4fc3ae !important;
}

.yh-text-white {
    color: #fff !important;
}


.yh-border-purple {
    border-color: #34215a !important;
}

.yh-border-rose {
    border-color: #f04d6e !important;
}

.yh-border-yellow {
    color: #f9ab23 !important;
}

.yh-border-green {
    color: #4fc3ae !important;
}

/* Import Source Sans Pro with ALL weights */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Sans+Pro:wght@300;400;600;700;900&display=swap');

/* ===== BUTTON TEXT VISIBILITY ===== */
button:disabled {
    color: var(--yh-light-purple) !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-light-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_brand,
.slds-button--brand,
button[class*="brand"],
input[class*="brand"],
a[class*="brand"] {
    color: white !important;
    background-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}



.slds-button_brand .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--brand .slds-button__icon,
button[class*="brand"] .slds-button__icon,
input[class*="brand"] .slds-button__icon,
a[class*="brand"] .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

/* Force white text on ANY element with purple background */
[style*="background-color: #34215a"],
[style*="background: #34215a"],
.bg-yh-purple,
.slds-brand-primary {
    color: white !important;
}

[style*="background-color: #f04d6e"],
[style*="background: #f04d6e"],
.bg-yh-purple,
.slds-brand-primary {
    color: white !important;
}

.slds-is-selected .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
    color: white !important;
}

[style*="background-color: #34215a"] .slds-button__icon,
[style*="background: #34215a"] .slds-button__icon,
[style*="background-color: #34215a"] .slds-icon,
[style*="background: #34215a"] .slds-icon,
.bg-yh-purple .slds-button__icon,
.slds-brand-primary .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

/* ===== ENFORCE NO ALL-CAPS ===== */
* {
    text-transform: none !important;
    font-variant: normal !important;
    letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

.slds-text-title,
.slds-text-title_caps,
.slds-section__title {
    text-transform: none !important;
    font-variant: normal !important;
    letter-spacing: normal !important;
}

/* Brand buttons */
.slds-button_brand,
.slds-button--brand {
    background-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    color: white !important;
}

.slds-button_brand .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--brand .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

/* Neutral buttons */
.slds-button_neutral,
.slds-button--neutral {
    background-color: white !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_neutral .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--neutral .slds-button__icon {
    fill: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

/* Bare buttons */
.slds-button_bare,
.slds-button--bare {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
    color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_bare .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--bare .slds-button__icon {
    fill: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_bare:hover,
.slds-button--bare:hover {
    background-color: #f5f5f5 !important;
    color: var(--yh-rose) !important;
}

.slds-button_bare:hover .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--bare:hover .slds-button__icon {
    fill: var(--yh-rose) !important;
}

/* Outline brand buttons */
.slds-button_outline-brand,
.slds-button--outline-brand {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_outline-brand .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--outline-brand .slds-button__icon {
    fill: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_outline-brand:hover,
.slds-button_outline-brand:focus {
    background-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    color: white !important;
}

.slds-button_outline-brand:hover .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button_outline-brand:focus .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

/* Success buttons */
.slds-button_success,
.slds-button--success {
    background-color: var(--yh-green) !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-green) !important;
    color: white !important;
}

/* Destructive buttons */
.slds-button_destructive,
.slds-button--destructive {
    background-color: var(--yh-rose) !important;
    border-color: var(--yh-rose) !important;
    color: white !important;
}

.slds-theme_error,
.slds-theme--error {
    background-color: var(--yh-rose) !important;
}

/* Inverse buttons */
.slds-button_inverse,
.slds-button--inverse {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    border-color: white !important;
    color: white !important;
}

.slds-button_inverse .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--inverse .slds-button__icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

.slds-button_inverse:hover,
.slds-button--inverse:hover {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}

.slds-button_inverse:hover .slds-button__icon,
.slds-button--inverse:hover .slds-button__icon {
    fill: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}



/* ===== DARK BACKGROUND TEXT VISIBILITY ===== */
.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation,
.bg-yh-purple,
[style*="background-color: #34215a"],
[style*="background: #34215a"] {
    color: white !important;
}

.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation a,
.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation span,
.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation div {
    color: white !important;
}

.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation a:hover {
    color: var(--yh-light-rose) !important;
}

.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation svg,
.bg-yh-purple svg,
.forceCommunityGlobalNavigation .slds-icon,
.bg-yh-purple .slds-icon {
    fill: white !important;
}

/* ===== FORM STYLES ===== */
.slds-input,
.slds-select,
.slds-textarea,
.slds-form-element__label {
    font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', Arial, sans-serif !important;
    /*font-size: var(--body-size) !important;
        font-weight: 400 !important;
        text-transform: none !important;*/
}

.slds-input:focus,
.slds-select:focus,
.slds-textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52, 33, 90, 0.1) !important;
}


/* =========== Text ========= */
.slds-truncate {
    font-size: inherit !important;
    line-height: inherit !important;
    font-weight: inherit !important;
}

.slds-table_header-fixed_container,
.slds-table--header-fixed_container {
    padding-top: 2rem !important;
}

/* Display larger than super headline (max 10x body size) */
.yh-display-large {
    font-size: 160px !important;
    line-height: 168px !important;
    font-weight: 900 !important;
}

/* Centered text for specific cases */
.yh-centered-text {
    text-align: center !important;
}


/* Responsive adjustments */
@media (max-width: 768px) {

    /* ===== CARD AND LAYOUT STYLES ===== */
    .slds-card {
        padding: 0px !important;
    }

    .yh-banner-content {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .yh-logo-section {
        margin-bottom: 15px;
    }

    .yh-search-section {
        margin: 15px 0;
        max-width: 100%;
    }

    .yh-user-section {
        margin-top: 15px;
    }
}

.yh-footer {
    font-family: FSElliot, sans-serif;
    color: white;
}
/********** FOOTER *********************/

/* Tablets */ 
@media (min-width: 600px) { 
    .yh-footer {
        font-family: FSElliot, sans-serif;
        color: white;
	}
} 
    
/* Desktop */ 
@media (min-width: 1024px) { 
    .yh-footer {
        font-family: FSElliot, sans-serif;
        color: white;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 1440px) {
    .yh-footer {
        font-family: FSElliot, sans-serif;
        color: white;
        font-size: .9rem;
        font-weight: 300;
    }
}
/************/
.yh-footer-left {
    margin: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 1px;
}
    
.yh-footer-left p {
    text-align: left;
    line-height: 20px;
}

p+p {
    margin-top: 10px;
}

p.copy-write {
    font-size: .75rem;
}

.helpCenterHomeHero .bgImage {
    border-radius: 0px 0px 50px 50px;
}

.forceCommunityThemeNav .mainNavItem .linkBtn {
    font-size: var(--body-size) !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.themeNav {
    visibility: var(--search-visible);
}

.forceCommunityTopArticleListForTopic .topicHeaderLink {
    font-size: x-large !important;
}

.expand-yellow-icon .slds-button_icon {
    background-color: var(--yh-rose);
    color: white;
}

.expand-yellow-icon .slds-button_icon:hover,
.expand-yellow-icon .slds-button_icon:focus {
    color: var(--yh-purple);
}



.balance-positive {
    color: var(--yh-green) !important;
}

.balance-negative {
    color: var(--yh-rose) !important;
}

.balance-amount {
    color: var(--yh-purple) !important;
}



.menu-icon-rose {
    --slds-c-icon-color-foreground: white !important;
    --slds-c-button-menu-icon-width: 3rem;
    --slds-c-button-menu-icon-height: 3rem;
    --slds-c-icon-width: 3rem;
    --slds-c-icon-height: 3rem;
    --lwc-buttonMenuIconSize: 3rem;
}
    
.menu-icon-rose button {
   padding :0px !important;     
}

.menu-icon-rose button :nth-child(2) {
    display: none !important;
}

.yh-footer-container {
  max-width: 1440px;     /* matches themeHeaderInner */
  margin: 0 auto;        /* center container */
  text-align: left;      /* left-align text inside */
  padding: 0px 16px;    /* responsive spacing (mobile-safe) */
}

.yh-footer p {
  margin: 0;
}

.yh-footer p + p {
  margin-top: 8px;
} 

    
/* ============================================================
   EXPERIENCE BUILDER – RESPONSIVE FIXED HEADER + STICKY FOOTER
   ============================================================ */

/* -------------------------
   Global layout variables
-------------------------*/
:root {
    --yh-header-height: 80px;
   /* --yh-footer-height: 80px;*/
    --yh-unified-bg: #EFEDF2;
}

/* -------------------------
   Wrapper
-------------------------*/
.themeLayoutStarterWrapper.siteforceThemeLayoutStarter {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 100dvh;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* -------------------------
   Fixed Header
-------------------------*/
.a11y-banner {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--yh-header-height);
    z-index: 1000;
}

/* -------------------------
   Scrollable Body
-------------------------*/
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true {
    display: flex;
    /*flex-direction: column;*/
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    padding-top: calc(var(--yh-header-height) + 10px);
    padding-bottom: 120px;
    overflow: visible;  
    min-height: auto; 
    /*min-height: calc(100vh - var(--yh-header-height) - var(--yh-footer-height));
    box-sizing: border-box;*/
}

/* -------------------------
   Footer (sticky bottom)
-------------------------*/
.themeLayoutStarterWrapper.siteforceThemeLayoutStarter > footer.footer {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--yh-footer-height);
    z-index: 1000;
}

/* -------------------------
   Flow button spacing
-------------------------*/
.flow-button {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* -------------------------
   Responsive Adjustments
-------------------------*/
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    :root {
        --yh-header-height: 60px;
        --yh-footer-height: 120px;
    }

    .body.isPageWidthFixed-true {
        padding-top: var(--yh-header-height);
        padding-bottom: var(--yh-footer-height);
        min-height: calc(100dvh - var(--yh-header-height) - var(--yh-footer-height));
    }
    .yh-footer {
    padding-bottom: 16px;
	}    
}    


/* ============================================================
   GLOBAL BACKGROUND VARIABLE
   ============================================================ */
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
}

/* FLOW RUNTIME — OUTER CONTAINERS (SCOPED) */
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-flow,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-lwc-body,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-progress-indicator,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-list-container,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-base-section,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true flowruntime-section-with-header,
.body.isPageWidthFixed-true lightning-accordion-section {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
}

/* FLOW SCREEN BODY — REMOVE WHITE CARD */
.flowruntimeBody,
.flowruntimeBody__lwc,
.flowruntimeBody.slds-card__body {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
}

/* FLOW NAVIGATION BAR */
flowruntime-navigation-bar,
.navigationBar,
.slds-card__footer {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
    border-top: none !important;
}
/* Navigation bar button font size */
flowruntime-navigation-bar lightning-button button {
    font-size: 16px; /* adjust as needed */
}    

/* FLOW DISPLAY TEXT — BACKGROUND ONLY */
.flowruntimeBody 
flowruntime-display-text-lwc 
lightning-formatted-rich-text 
span[part="formatted-rich-text"],
.flowruntimeBody 
flowruntime-display-text-lwc 
lightning-formatted-rich-text 
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
}

/* SAFETY — STRIP INLINE WHITE BACKGROUNDS */
.flowruntimeBody 
lightning-formatted-rich-text 
[style*="background"] {
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* FLOW DISPLAY TEXT — REQUIRED FIELD NOTICE ONLY */
.flowruntimeBody
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p strong em {
    font-size: 16px !important;
}  

/* FLOW DISPLAY TEXT — CENTERED CONFIRMATION MESSAGE ONLY */
.flowruntimeBody
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p[style*="text-align: center"] > span {
    font-size: 16px !important;
} 
    
/* FLOW DISPLAY TEXT — INSTRUCTION / CONFIRMATION TEXT ONLY */
.flowruntimeBody
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p > span[style*="font-size"],
.flowruntimeBody
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p > strong[style*="font-size"] {
    font-size: 16px !important;
} 

.flowruntimeBody
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] p > strong[style*="font-size: 36px"] {
    font-size: 36px !important;
}    
    
flowruntime-lwc-field.field-element
flowruntime-display-text-lwc
lightning-formatted-rich-text
span[part="formatted-rich-text"] ul li > span[style*="font-size"] {
    font-size: 16px !important;
}
    
/* ============================================================
   PAGE / FLOW HEADER BACKGROUND
   ============================================================ */
.yh-page-header-bg {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
}

.yh-page-header-bg.slds-page-header {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Accordion headers rendered inside Flow */
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__summary,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__section,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__list-item {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
}

/* ============================================================
   FLOW ACCORDION — REMOVE WHITE BACKGROUNDS
   ============================================================ */
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__list-item,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__section,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__summary,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__summary-heading,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-accordion__content {
    background-color: var(--yh-unified-bg) !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    font-size: 20px !important;
}
/* ============================================================
   FLOW — ZERO BORDERS (HARD RESET)
   ============================================================ */

flowruntime-flow,
.flowruntimeBody,
.flowruntimeBody.slds-card__body,
flowruntime-navigation-bar,
.slds-card,
.slds-card__body,
.slds-card__footer,
.slds-page-header,
.slds-accordion__section,
.slds-accordion__summary,
.slds-accordion__list-item,
.slds-form-element,
.slds-form-element__control {
    border: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/*Flow Text Font size*/
.flowruntimeBody,
.flowruntimeBody__lwc {
  font-size: 16px;
}

/* Increase label font size for Flow form elements (including picklists) */
.flowruntimeBody .slds-form-element__label,
.flowruntimeBody__lwc .slds-form-element__label,
.flowruntimeBody .slds-form-element lightning-formatted-rich-text,
.flowruntimeBody__lwc .slds-form-element lightning-formatted-rich-text {
  font-size: 16px !important;
}    
    
} 
    
.yh-footer {
    background-color: var(--yh-purple) !important; 
    color: #ffffff !important;
    padding: 12px 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    font-family: FSElliot, sans-serif;
}

.yh-footer-container {
    max-width: 965px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 20px;
}

.yh-footer-text {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
   
}

.yh-footer .copy-write {
    display: flex !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    align-items: center !important; 
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    padding-top: 8px;
}

.yh-footer .copy-write a {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    text-decoration: underline;
}

footer.footer, .cFooterPanel {
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/*Cookies Text Formatting in Footer*/    
.yh-footer a[href="cookie"], .yh-footer a[href="accessibility-statement"] {
  text-decoration: underline !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}
    
</style>
